comparison.objective: Tighten a tourniquet to the green pressure range and lock its windlass rod.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated windlass turning with regrasp/hand-off under spring backdrive, followed by snap-in latching.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge at least 250 mmHg, rod locked, and robot clear for one second; premature locking or unlocked release loses credit.
comparison.reason: Tests backdriven rotary tightening and latching rather than axial tool alignment, percussion fracture, and loose-fragment collection.
